items.title: Wendell Brunious interviewed by Michael Woods, Los Angeles, California, September 3, 1995 [interview 1 of 2]
items.q: [INTERVIEWER] ...introduce a very good friend of mine ... Mr. Wendell Brunious. >> [INTERVIEWEE] Thank you, Daniel.

ctx.x: Well I guess we’re on camera. My name is Dan Barrett and I’m privileged and honored to introduce a very good friend of mine and a terrific trumpet player from New Orleans, Mr. Wendell Brunious.
